decision: Design-only preregistration. Do not mutate the registry from this artifact. The source-wall rule is implemented preview-only; build the fingerprint, ontology node, OOS preregistration, source runner, bounded preview, row guardrail audit, novelty/cap replay, tests, and explicit apply gate before any labels are admitted.
implementation_next_steps: Add a new n_ribosyl_hydrolase fingerprint and ontology node that separates N-glycosidic bond hydrolysis from O-glycoside hydrolase, phosphorylase, kinase, and transferase chemistry.

Keep the preview-only external_cofactor_ec_disambiguation rule green: it admits only rows with non-EC N-ribosyl hydrolase family text plus N-glycosidic hydrolysis evidence; EC 3.2.2 remains scope/fetch context only.
Refresh the hard-negative OOS preregistration for the 42-positive-fingerprint universe before any apply.
Implement a reviewed UniProt source runner with bounded windows and entry-fetch timeouts if needed.
Run non-destructive preview, row guardrail audit, novelty/governor/dedup/cap admission, and apply only if all mechanism-first gates pass.
